increment_paragraph: **TAIL-FILE-DEFINITION-CENSUS-INCOMPLETE** (named follow-up of LERI-CROSS-UNIT-ELEMENTS-RELEASED; new rule 49; Lean `QCore.GuardCorrelatedCensus`; [report](../../reports/tail-file-definition-census-incomplete/README.md)). Fluent Bit 90978ac6's `plugins/in_tail/tail_file.c` (`tag_compose`) opens `else {` inside one `#ifdef FLB_HAVE_REGEX` group and closes it inside a second; E01-RAW-COND refused each group alone, ended the file one brace deep (hiding 16 of 48 definitions) and so refused the unit's census and the tail-pause slice's whole import phase. Rule 49 decides a raw scan whose only ground is that arm disagreement by guard correlation, without evaluating any conditional: one scan per world of `#ifdef`/`#ifndef NAME` assumptions (a guard group with no `#elif` is read under the world's assumption, splitting when it has none), every other group's arms must still agree in every world, every other directive and `_Pragma` clears assumptions, equal worlds merge keeping shared assumptions, more than 64 worlds or a directive spelling a macro-table operator refuse; the collected names are unioned into the census, anything undecided keeps the refusal. Lean proves the assumption bookkeeping, the measured shape (refused by E01-RAW-COND, decided and sound here), the negatives and soundness over every stream of length at most four against a selection semantics, tied to the Rust by a checksum. Measured on the card's own `prepare --link` of 90978ac6: the slice's import phase now runs (rule 40: home exports 8 -> 10); no row moves (59/1/340/4 Pending); four Unknown rows lose a home-call leaf and keep others (`in_tail_exit`, `flb_tail_config_destroy`, `flb_tail_scan`, `flb_input_collectors_start`); declared measurement (stated map, slice): match. No system or corpus unit has the refusal; `libevent-core`'s two (`buffer.c`, `bufferevent_sock.c`) are now decided, unmeasured (follow-up LIBEVENT-CORE-CENSUS-GUARD-CORRELATION).
